title: A WebSocket program that only sends is ended by its next `send` once the period has passed, and a sleep on the connection is cut by the drain
scope:
what the drain does with a WebSocket program that never calls `receive`: what its
`send` does after the period, and what a `Core\Time::sleep` on that connection does under a
drain. A program parked on something that is neither the socket nor a sleep is left as it is.
